name: Torrezon
description: Torrezon, also called Alta Torrezon, is a continent that is the homeland of the vampires and was once the seat of the Church and Crown that guarded the Immortal Sun.

description_citations.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake

"Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: In the telling, Pedron the Wicked kills the guardians of the Immortal Sun and a winged beast steals the Sun from him.
timeline.quote: Pedron the Wicked killed them all.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vona's backstory: she relished the Apostasine Wars and her second birth as a vampire, and secretly still loves bloodshed.
timeline.quote: the day of her second birth, spent kneeling in a church, working the spell that would bind her life to serve the crown and church in perpetuity

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Bored in peacetime, Vona killed all her human serfs in a week-long game and abandoned her estate (flashback).
timeline.quote: over the course of one happy week killed each of them as part of a pleasant game

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vona volunteers to lead the first ship in Queen Miralda's fleet searching for Saint Elenda.
timeline.quote: Vona had volunteered to lead the first ship that left port.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Angrath calls every group on Ixalan ants on an anthill.
timeline.quote: The Sun Empire are ants on an anthill, and so are the River Heralds and so is Torrezon and so is every other group of idiots on this plane.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor explains he gave the Immortal Sun to a monastery in Torrezon and then to others who proved unworthy.
timeline.quote: I initially gifted it to a monastery in the east, in Torrezon.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor severs his spark on the shores of Torrezon to create the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: severing his spark to create the artifact he called the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor waits in vain for Ugin's signal, left without a spark and a prisoner.
timeline.quote: Azor was left without a spark, and his prison without a prisoner.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Elenda explains her order was meant to guard the Immortal Sun, not use it, and that she sealed herself away here.
timeline.quote: Our order was meant to guard the Immortal Sun, not to use it.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vona says they conquered Torrezon and built an empire in Elenda's honor.
timeline.quote: We conquered Torrezon,

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Apatzec declares Orazca the Sun Empire's again and names Torrezon as next.
timeline.quote: Ixalan is ours . . . and Torrezon is next.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vona refuses to return to Torrezon empty-handed (non-canon Legion of Dusk ending).
timeline.quote: I will not return to Torrezon empty-handed,

timeline.summary: Amalia sends word of Aclazotz's threat home through the Queen's Bay Company.
timeline.quote: she had sent word to her family and Queen Miralda through the remaining Queen's Bay Company members of the oncoming storm Aclazotz might bring.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz, in the hold of a ship bound for Torrezon, plans to conquer it and later destroy Chimil.
timeline.quote: Soon the ship would reach Torrezon, a land of sheep awaiting their promised shepherd to lead them to eternal life.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz singles out Vona de Iedo as the vampire he wants at his right wing.
timeline.quote: One vampire he craved above all others: Vona de Iedo, the Antifex.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz escapes to Torrezon on a Dusk Legion ship to find Vona.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz escaped, securing passage to Torrezon on a Dusk Legion ship.

citation.text: "Aclazotz", section "Freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk completes its conquest of Torrezon around 98 BD and the survivors of the Free Cities flee to the sea.
timeline.quote: When the Legion of Dusk completed their conquest of Torrezon around 98 BD

citation.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pedron raids the monastery guarding the Immortal Sun; it is stolen by a winged beast and Elenda follows it west.
timeline.quote: The monastery was raided by Pedron the Wicked , who killed most of its occupants.

citation.text: "Elenda of Garrano", section "Warrior nun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elenda resorts to dark magic and immortality, searches for centuries, returns to teach her Rite to nobles, then sails west again.
timeline.quote: Elenda resorted to dark magic and took on the burden of immortality until the Immortal Sun could be retrieved once again.

citation.text: "Elenda of Garrano", section "Vampire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Back in Torrezon Elenda preaches humility and restraint, which some such as Vito refuse to heed.
timeline.quote: Elenda began preaching a message of humility and restraint

citation.text: "Elenda of Garrano", section "Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hostile forces under Pedron the Wicked attack the monastery in Torrezon; Azor takes the Sun across the sea to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: The Sun was taken by Azor, and he brought it across the sea to the continent of Ixalan

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "Torrezon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the invasion the Sun Empire moves its capital back to Orazca and begins a campaign to invade Torrezon using reverse-engineered ships.
timeline.quote: the Sun Empire moved its capital back to Orazca

citation.text: "Ixalan (continent)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pedron the Wicked steals the Immortal Sun from its monastery but Azor reclaims it.
timeline.quote: stole the Immortal Sun but lost it to Azor, who reclaimed it

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The first vampire, Elenda of Garrano, ends Torrezon's three-century religious war; the Legion of Dusk conquers the continent and the Brazen Coalition forms.
timeline.quote: their inhabitants took to the sea and formed the Brazen Coalition

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Immortal Sun is placed in Alta Torrezon's care by Azor, then stolen by Pedron the Wicked who loses it to Azor.
timeline.quote: The monastery fell under attack by the forces of the rival king Pedron the Wicked who stole the Immortal Sun but in turn, lost it to Azor.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The monarch's death splits the kingdom and Alta Torrezon explodes into civil war in 803 BD.
timeline.quote: Alta Torrezon exploded into civil war.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The Apostasine Wars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The civil war rages for two hundred and fifty years before a mutual cessation of hostilities.
timeline.quote: The civil war raged on for two hundred and fifty years, with the children of all three rulers carrying on the conflict.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The Apostasine Wars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 495 BD a stranger wreathed in black vapor routs the apostasine princes' army outside Alta Torrezon.
timeline.quote: wreathed in rippling black vapor, this rider charged into the honor guard of the apostate princes, slaughtering all in her path

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The Gift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elenda gives the gift of vampirism to Alta Torrezon's loyalist nobility, founding the Rite of Redemption.
timeline.quote: This ritualistic blessing of the chosen with vampirism became known as the Rite of Redemption.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The Gift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A vast undead army calling itself the Legion of Dusk marches from Alta Torrezon on a campaign of conquest.
timeline.quote: They called themselves the Legion of Dusk .

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The conquest of Torrezon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The last independent city-states of the southern coast fall, sending refugees fleeing across the sea.
timeline.quote: the few remaining independent city-states on the continent's southern coast would fall to the Legion's armies

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The conquest of Torrezon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Torrezon splits between orthodoxy under Mavren Fein and radicals under Vona.
timeline.quote: The church orthodoxy is directed by Pontifex Mavren Fein.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The crisis of faith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elenda becomes a vampire after the Immortal Sun is stolen and teaches her Rite to the nobles; Mavren Fein is an early convert.
timeline.quote: Mavren Fein was one of her early converts

citation.text: "Mavren Fein", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Queen Miralda orders the Legion of Dusk to create the Queen's Bay Company after the invasion.
timeline.quote: Queen Miralda ordered the Legion of Dusk to create a new commercial venture

citation.text: "Queen's Bay Company", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Orazca retaken, the empire pushes the Legion of Dusk back to the sea and prepares an invasion of Torrezon.
timeline.quote: With Orazca retaken, the Sun Empire pushed the Legion of Dusk back to the sea

citation.text: "Sun Empire", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The dead monarch's children split the kingdom; the sister refuses her brothers' demand to divide her inheritance and civil war erupts.
timeline.quote: She refused, and Alta Torrezon exploded into civil war.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "The Apostasine Wars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The church declares the brothers heretics and the Apostasine Wars begin.
timeline.quote: Quickly, most of the church's leadership declared the brothers to be heretics, apostates who had turned from the divine plan to glorify themselves.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "The Apostasine Wars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The civil war rages for two hundred and fifty years.
timeline.quote: The civil war raged on for two hundred and fifty years, with the children of all three rulers carrying on the conflict.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "The Apostasine Wars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As defeat seems certain, Elenda charges into the apostate princes' guard and routs their army.
timeline.quote: Just as defeat seemed certain, a stranger emerged: wreathed in rippling black vapor, this rider charged into the honor guard of the apostate princes, slaughtering all in her path.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "The Gift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Loyalist nobility partake of Elenda's gift of vampirism, the Rite of Redemption.
timeline.quote: With the church's blessing, loyalist nobility partook of Elenda's gift.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "The Gift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Strengthened by vampirism, the rulers begin a campaign of conquest across the continent.
timeline.quote: Bolstered with vampiric strength and appetite, they began a campaign of conquest across the continent.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "The conquest of Torrezon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An undead army crosses the Deoro and calls itself the Legion of Dusk.
timeline.quote: They called themselves the Legion of Dusk .

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "The conquest of Torrezon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Over four centuries Alta Torrezon swallows kingdoms and drives refugees toward the coast.
timeline.quote: For four more centuries, the armies of Alta Torrezon inexorably swallowed up kingdom after kingdom, expanding outward from their mountainous home, driving waves of refugees toward the free cities on the coast.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "The conquest of Torrezon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Torrezon is not spared the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: The continent of Torrezon was not spared the New Phyrexian Invasion .

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "The Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Queen Miralda's order for paladins to hold back while the Free Cities were butchered draws church condemnation.
timeline.quote: Queen Miralda 's order for paladins to stay their blades while the Free Cities were butchered drew condemnation from a growing faction of the Church.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "The Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Church factions form behind Pontifex Mavren Fein and Antifex Vona de Iedo, with separatists opposing Queen Miralda.
timeline.quote: The radicals look to Antifex Vona de Iedo for guidance.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "The crisis of faith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Torrezon's victory, Vona slaughters her serfs and becomes a duelist.
timeline.quote: she slaughtered her own human serfs and abandoned her humble estate

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Conquest of the free cities". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Angry at Elenda's pacifism, Vona begins a schism calling herself the Antifex.
timeline.quote: began a schism within the Church of Dusk

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Antifex". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Vito's death, Aclazotz identifies Vona as a prime candidate to be his champion.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz identified Vona as a prime candidate to be his champion

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Antifex". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: iron-fisted monarch allied with the church
relations.quote: The Legion of Dusk is an alliance between the powerful Church of Dusk and the iron-fisted monarch Queen Miralda .

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "Structure and rituals". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: The Legion of Dusk rules the continent.
relations.quote: It is ruled by the Legion of Dusk .

citation.text: "Torrezon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: deep in Torrezon's interior in the far northeast amid a vast mountain range.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
